US and Iran reach peace deal, impacting oil prices and Strait of Hormuz

The United States and Iran have reached a peace agreement, leading to the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. This development has caused a significant drop in crude oil prices. While some outlets highlight the economic implications and the end of a long standoff, others question the value of the deal for the US.
